items: 【Built for the Outdoors】Crafted from powder-coated galvanized steel, this outdoor furniture set offers exceptional durability and excellent corrosion resistance, making it ideal for outdoor use. Its sturdy structure ensures stability and safety. Additionally, the PVC rattan used boasts high resilience, rain or shine - so you can enjoy the ultimate in outdoor relaxation with minimal upkeep

【Wide Armrest Design】The patio furniture set is ergonomically designed with a unique slanted backrest and wide armrest that closely conforms to the natural curves of the human body when seated. The seat cushions are also equipped with an anti-slip point design to prevent them from easily slipping off. You can enjoy extended periods of outdoor rest without feeling tired

【55000 BTU Fire Pit Table】Using a dual-tube stainless steel burner, the heat output is 55,000 BTU after ignition, which keeps stable and fully burned, providing sufficient warmth. Propane fuel allows you to no longer suffer from ash and smoke

【Comfortable and Removable Cushions】Our cushions are made of 100% polyester fabric, water-repellent, and long-lasting. Filled with a premium 4" sponge to stay fluffy and non-deformation, while the washable covers ensure effortless maintenance, elevating your outdoor relaxation experience

【Quick & Hassle-Free Assembly】 Designed with your convenience in mind, this set includes all necessary tools and clearly illustrated instructions for straightforward setup. The thoughtful, user-friendly design allows for fast and simple assembly, so you can start enjoying your new outdoor space in no time. Please note: due to its generous size, this rattan conversation set may arrive in multiple carefully packaged shipments
